source_description: Provider-authored data:image/svg+xml logo in the public app login page img; its separate two-path leaf symbol is also used in the official app icon at https://app.farmbrite.com/icons/icon-192x192.png.
license: Farmbrite brand mark, used nominatively; trademark rights remain with Farmbrite.
edits: Decoded the provider-authored inline SVG from the public app login page without altering path data.
Removed g#farmbrite containing the two wordmark paths; retained both original symbol paths and their transforms.
Cropped viewBox to 25 17 67 138 and matched width/height to the retained mark.
Recoloured only the dark teal #0B4040 symbol path to #FFFFFF for dark tiles; retained the original #34A853 green path.
notes: The company app icon uses this two-part leaf symbol. Only the symbol is retained, without the app icon green tile or a new background. No paths were written, traced or generated.
